summary.text: Raymond Crews is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives, representing District 8 (Bossier Parish), and was elected in 2017, according to the official House member page. Raymond Crews chairs the Labor and Industrial Relations Committee.

paragraphs.text: The member page lists Raymond Crews's occupation as USAFR, Retired; Airline Pilot; Small Business Owner - Aerial Mapping and Energy Consulting.
It lists education as B.S., Computer Science, Texas A&M University.

The page lists committee assignments including Labor and Industrial Relations (chair), Health and Welfare, the House Select Committee on Homeland Security and the Special Committee on Military and Veterans Affairs, and caucus affiliations including the Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, the Louisiana Rural Caucus and the North Louisiana Legislative Delegation.
